INSERT INTO market_daily_price ( trade_date, asset_code, asset_type, asset_name, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, market_cap, sector, ytm ) VALUES
( #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.assetCode}, #{item.assetType}, #{item.assetName}, #{item.openPrice}::numeric, #{item.highPrice}::numeric, #{item.lowPrice}::numeric, #{item.closePrice}::numeric, #{item.volume}, #{item.marketCap}, #{item.sector}, #{item.ytm}::numeric )
ON CONFLICT (trade_date, asset_code, asset_type) DO UPDATE SET asset_name = EXCLUDED.asset_name, open_price = EXCLUDED.open_price, high_price = EXCLUDED.high_price, low_price = EXCLUDED.low_price, close_price = EXCLUDED.close_price, volume = EXCLUDED.volume, market_cap = EXCLUDED.market_cap, sector = EXCLUDED.sector, ytm = EXCLUDED.ytm
mapper.select: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.asset_code) p.* FROM market_daily_price p JOIN market_daily_price s ON s.asset_code = p.asset_code AND s.asset_type = p.asset_type AND s.trade_date = ( SELECT MIN(trade_date) FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_code = p.asset_code AND asset_type = p.asset_type AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ) WHERE p.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND p.trade_date = ( SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_code = p.asset_code AND asset_type = p.asset_type AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ) AND p.sector IS NOT NULL AND s.close_price > 0 ORDER BY p.asset_code, ((p.close_price - s.close_price) / s.close_price) DESC ) SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY sector, market_cap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{topN}

WITH start_price AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_code) asset_code, close_price AS start_close FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY asset_code, trade_date ), end_price AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_code) * FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY asset_code, trade_date DESC ) SELECT e.* FROM end_price e JOIN start_price s ON s.asset_code = e.asset_code WHERE s.start_close > 0 ORDER BY ((e.close_price - s.start_close) / s.start_close) DESC LIMIT #{topN}

WITH raw_months AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date AS month_key, MIN(trade_date) AS rebalance_date, MAX(trade_date) AS exit_date FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date ), months AS ( SELECT rm.*, ( SELECT MAX(p.trade_date) FROM market_daily_price p WHERE p.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND p.trade_date < rm.rebalance_date ) AS signal_date FROM raw_months rm ), candidates AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, m.exit_date, buy.asset_code, buy.asset_name, buy.asset_type, buy.sector, COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price) AS buy_price, COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) AS sell_price, start_price.close_price AS start_price, buy.market_cap, ((signal.close_price - start_price.close_price) / NULLIF(start_price.close_price, 0)) AS score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY m.rebalance_date ORDER BY ((signal.close_price - start_price.close_price) / NULLIF(start_price.close_price, 0)) DESC, buy.market_cap DESC NULLS LAST ) AS pick_rank FROM months m JOIN market_daily_price buy ON buy.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND buy.trade_date = m.rebalance_date JOIN market_daily_price signal ON signal.asset_type = buy.asset_type AND signal.asset_code = buy.asset_code AND signal.trade_date = m.signal_date JOIN market_daily_price sell ON sell.asset_type = buy.asset_type AND sell.asset_code = buy.asset_code AND sell.trade_date = m.exit_date JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.close_price FROM market_daily_price p WHERE p.asset_type = signal.asset_type AND p.asset_code = signal.asset_code AND p.trade_date <= m.signal_date ORDER BY p.trade_date DESC OFFSET #{lookbackDays} LIMIT 1 ) start_price ON TRUE WHERE buy.close_price IS NOT NULL AND sell.close_price IS NOT NULL AND start_price.close_price > 0 ) SELECT rebalance_date AS rebalanceDate, exit_date AS exitDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, asset_type AS assetType, sector, buy_price AS buyPrice, sell_price AS sellPrice, score, market_cap AS marketCap, pick_rank AS pickRank FROM candidates WHERE pick_rank <= #{topN} ORDER BY rebalance_date, pick_rank

WITH months AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date AS month_key, MIN(trade_date) AS rebalance_date, MAX(trade_date) AS exit_date FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date ), sector_scores AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, buy.sector, AVG((buy.close_price - start_price.close_price) / NULLIF(start_price.close_price, 0)) AS sector_return, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY m.rebalance_date ORDER BY AVG((buy.close_price - start_price.close_price) / NULLIF(start_price.close_price, 0)) DESC ) AS sector_rank FROM months m JOIN market_daily_price buy ON buy.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND buy.trade_date = m.rebalance_date AND buy.sector IS NOT NULL JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.close_price FROM market_daily_price p WHERE p.asset_type = buy.asset_type AND p.asset_code = buy.asset_code AND p.trade_date <= m.rebalance_date ORDER BY p.trade_date DESC OFFSET #{lookbackDays} LIMIT 1 ) start_price ON TRUE WHERE start_price.close_price > 0 GROUP BY m.rebalance_date, buy.sector ), sector_members AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, m.exit_date, buy.asset_code, buy.asset_name, buy.asset_type, buy.sector, COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price) AS buy_price, COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) AS sell_price, s.sector_return AS score, buy.market_cap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY m.rebalance_date, buy.sector ORDER BY buy.market_cap DESC NULLS LAST, buy.asset_code ) AS member_rank, s.sector_rank FROM months m JOIN sector_scores s ON s.rebalance_date = m.rebalance_date AND s.sector_rank <= #{topSectors} JOIN market_daily_price buy ON buy.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND buy.trade_date = m.rebalance_date AND buy.sector = s.sector JOIN market_daily_price sell ON sell.asset_type = buy.asset_type AND sell.asset_code = buy.asset_code AND sell.trade_date = m.exit_date ) SELECT rebalance_date AS rebalanceDate, exit_date AS exitDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, asset_type AS assetType, sector, buy_price AS buyPrice, sell_price AS sellPrice, score, market_cap AS marketCap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY sector_rank, member_rank) AS pickRank FROM sector_members WHERE member_rank <= #{topStocksPerSector} ORDER BY rebalance_date, pickRank

WITH months AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date AS month_key, MIN(trade_date) AS rebalance_date, MAX(trade_date) AS exit_date FROM market_daily_price WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND asset_code IN ('KOSPI', 'KOSDAQ', 'GOLD', 'KTB3Y') GROUP BY date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date ), scored AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, m.exit_date, buy.asset_code, buy.asset_name, buy.asset_type, buy.sector, COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price) AS buy_price, COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) AS sell_price, start_price.close_price AS start_price, buy.market_cap, ((buy.close_price - start_price.close_price) / NULLIF(start_price.close_price, 0)) AS score, CASE WHEN buy.asset_code IN ('KOSPI', 'KOSDAQ', 'GOLD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS risk_asset FROM months m JOIN market_daily_price buy ON buy.trade_date = m.rebalance_date AND buy.asset_code IN ('KOSPI', 'KOSDAQ', 'GOLD', 'KTB3Y') JOIN market_daily_price sell ON sell.asset_type = buy.asset_type AND sell.asset_code = buy.asset_code AND sell.trade_date = m.exit_date JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.close_price FROM market_daily_price p WHERE p.asset_type = buy.asset_type AND p.asset_code = buy.asset_code AND p.trade_date <= m.rebalance_date ORDER BY p.trade_date DESC OFFSET #{lookbackDays} LIMIT 1 ) start_price ON TRUE WHERE buy.close_price IS NOT NULL AND sell.close_price IS NOT NULL AND start_price.close_price > 0 ), best_risk AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (rebalance_date) * FROM scored WHERE risk_asset = 1 ORDER BY rebalance_date, score DESC ), defensive AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (rebalance_date) * FROM scored WHERE asset_code IN ('KTB3Y', 'GOLD') ORDER BY rebalance_date, CASE WHEN asset_code = 'KTB3Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, score DESC ), picked AS ( SELECT COALESCE( CASE WHEN br.score > 0 THEN br.asset_code END, d.asset_code ) AS chosen_code, m.rebalance_date FROM months m LEFT JOIN best_risk br ON br.rebalance_date = m.rebalance_date LEFT JOIN defensive d ON d.rebalance_date = m.rebalance_date ) SELECT s.rebalance_date AS rebalanceDate, s.exit_date AS exitDate, s.asset_code AS assetCode, s.asset_name AS assetName, s.asset_type AS assetType, s.sector, s.buy_price AS buyPrice, s.sell_price AS sellPrice, s.score, s.market_cap AS marketCap, 1 AS pickRank FROM scored s JOIN picked p ON p.rebalance_date = s.rebalance_date AND p.chosen_code = s.asset_code ORDER BY s.rebalance_date

WITH weeks AS ( SELECT date_trunc('week', trade_date)::date AS week_key, MIN(trade_date) AS rebalance_date, MAX(trade_date) AS exit_date FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY date_trunc('week', trade_date)::date ), candidates AS ( SELECT w.rebalance_date, w.exit_date, buy.asset_code, buy.asset_name, buy.asset_type, buy.sector, COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price) AS buy_price, COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) AS sell_price, start_price.close_price AS start_price, buy.market_cap, ((buy.close_price - start_price.close_price) / NULLIF(start_price.close_price, 0)) AS short_return, (-1 * ((buy.close_price - start_price.close_price) / NULLIF(start_price.close_price, 0))) AS score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY w.rebalance_date ORDER BY ((buy.close_price - start_price.close_price) / NULLIF(start_price.close_price, 0)) ASC, buy.market_cap DESC NULLS LAST ) AS pick_rank FROM weeks w JOIN market_daily_price buy ON buy.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND buy.trade_date = w.rebalance_date JOIN market_daily_price sell ON sell.asset_type = buy.asset_type AND sell.asset_code = buy.asset_code AND sell.trade_date = w.exit_date JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.close_price FROM market_daily_price p WHERE p.asset_type = buy.asset_type AND p.asset_code = buy.asset_code AND p.trade_date <= w.rebalance_date ORDER BY p.trade_date DESC OFFSET #{lookbackDays} LIMIT 1 ) start_price ON TRUE WHERE buy.close_price IS NOT NULL AND sell.close_price IS NOT NULL AND start_price.close_price > 0 AND COALESCE(buy.market_cap, 0) >= #{minMarketCap} AND COALESCE(buy.volume, 0) >= #{minVolume} AND ((buy.close_price - start_price.close_price) / NULLIF(start_price.close_price, 0)) < 0 ) SELECT rebalance_date AS rebalanceDate, exit_date AS exitDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, asset_type AS assetType, sector, buy_price AS buyPrice, sell_price AS sellPrice, score, market_cap AS marketCap, pick_rank AS pickRank FROM candidates WHERE pick_rank <= #{topN} ORDER BY rebalance_date, pick_rank

WITH raw_months AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date AS month_key, MIN(trade_date) AS rebalance_date, MAX(trade_date) AS exit_date FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date ), months AS ( SELECT rm.*, ( SELECT MAX(f.signal_date) FROM quant_core_feature_snapshot f WHERE f.model_code = 'MP_CORE' AND f.signal_date < rm.rebalance_date ) AS signal_date FROM raw_months rm ), regime AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, idx.close_price AS kospi_close, ma.ma120, ma.ma200, CASE WHEN idx.close_price IS NULL OR ma.ma120 IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN idx.close_price > ma.ma120 AND (ma.ma200 IS NULL OR idx.close_price > ma.ma200) THEN 'RISK_ON' WHEN idx.close_price > ma.ma120 THEN 'NEUTRAL' ELSE 'RISK_OFF' END AS regime_state FROM months m LEFT JOIN market_daily_price idx ON idx.asset_type = 'INDEX' AND idx.asset_code = 'KOSPI' AND idx.trade_date = m.signal_date LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT AVG(close_price) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 120) AS ma120, AVG(close_price) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 200) AS ma200 FROM ( SELECT close_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'INDEX' AND asset_code = 'KOSPI' AND trade_date <= m.signal_date ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 200 ) rows ) ma ON TRUE ), feature_rows AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, m.exit_date, f.signal_date, f.asset_code, f.asset_name, f.market, f.sector, (f.features->>'ret20d')::numeric AS ret_20d, (f.features->>'ret60d')::numeric AS ret_60d, (f.features->>'ret120d')::numeric AS ret_120d, (f.features->>'ret252d')::numeric AS ret_252d, (f.features->>'riskAdjRet60d')::numeric AS risk_adj_ret_60d, (f.features->>'riskAdjRet252d')::numeric AS risk_adj_ret_252d, (f.features->>'drawdown60d')::numeric AS drawdown_60d, (f.features->>'tradeAmount20dAvg')::numeric AS trade_amount_20d_avg, (f.features->>'vol60d')::numeric AS vol_60d, r.regime_state FROM months m LEFT JOIN regime r ON r.rebalance_date = m.rebalance_date JOIN quant_core_feature_snapshot f ON f.model_code = 'MP_CORE' AND f.signal_date = m.signal_date WHERE m.signal_date IS NOT NULL ), ranked_features AS ( SELECT *, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY signal_date ORDER BY risk_adj_ret_60d), 0) AS risk_adj_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY signal_date ORDER BY risk_adj_ret_252d), 0) AS long_risk_adj_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY signal_date ORDER BY ret_60d), 0) AS ret_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY signal_date ORDER BY ret_20d), 0) AS short_momentum_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY signal_date ORDER BY ret_120d), 0) AS medium_momentum_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY signal_date ORDER BY trade_amount_20d_avg), 0) AS liquidity_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY signal_date ORDER BY vol_60d DESC), 0) AS stability_rank, GREATEST(LEAST(COALESCE(1 + drawdown_60d, 0.5), 1), 0) AS drawdown_score FROM feature_rows WHERE ret_20d IS NOT NULL AND ret_60d IS NOT NULL AND ret_120d IS NOT NULL AND risk_adj_ret_60d IS NOT NULL AND trade_amount_20d_avg IS NOT NULL ), scored AS ( SELECT *, ( 0.20 * risk_adj_rank + 0.10 * COALESCE(long_risk_adj_rank, risk_adj_rank) + 0.25 * short_momentum_rank + 0.15 * medium_momentum_rank + 0.15 * liquidity_rank + 0.10 * stability_rank + 0.05 * drawdown_score - CASE WHEN regime_state = 'RISK_OFF' THEN 0.15 WHEN regime_state = 'NEUTRAL' THEN 0.05 ELSE 0 END ) AS score FROM ranked_features WHERE liquidity_rank >= 0.20 AND COALESCE(drawdown_60d, 0) > -0.30 AND COALESCE(vol_60d, 0) <= 0.12 AND COALESCE(ret_60d, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(regime_state, 'UNKNOWN') IN ('RISK_ON', 'NEUTRAL') ), candidates AS ( SELECT s.rebalance_date, s.exit_date, buy.asset_code, buy.asset_name, buy.asset_type, buy.sector, COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price) AS buy_price, COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) AS sell_price, s.score, buy.market_cap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s.rebalance_date ORDER BY s.score DESC, s.liquidity_rank DESC, buy.market_cap DESC NULLS LAST, buy.asset_code ) AS pick_rank FROM scored s JOIN market_daily_price buy ON buy.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND buy.asset_code = s.asset_code AND buy.trade_date = s.rebalance_date JOIN market_daily_price sell ON sell.asset_type = buy.asset_type AND sell.asset_code = buy.asset_code AND sell.trade_date = s.exit_date WHERE buy.close_price IS NOT NULL AND sell.close_price IS NOT NULL ) SELECT rebalance_date AS rebalanceDate, exit_date AS exitDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, asset_type AS assetType, sector, buy_price AS buyPrice, sell_price AS sellPrice, score, market_cap AS marketCap, pick_rank AS pickRank FROM candidates WHERE pick_rank <= #{topN} ORDER BY rebalance_date, pick_rank
mapper.insert: WITH stock_base AS ( SELECT p.*, LAG(p.close_price, 20) OVER w AS close_20d, LAG(p.close_price, 60) OVER w AS close_60d, AVG(p.close_price) OVER (PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma20, AVG(p.close_price) OVER (PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma60, MAX(p.high_price) OVER (PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS high20, MAX(p.high_price) OVER (PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 60 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS high60_prior, MIN(p.low_price) OVER (PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS low20, AVG(p.close_price * COALESCE(p.volume, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS trade_amount20_avg, AVG(COALESCE(p.volume, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS volume20_avg FROM market_daily_price p WHERE p.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND p.trade_date BETWEEN CAST(#{fromDate} AS date) - INTERVAL '400 days' AND #{toDate} WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY p.asset_code ORDER BY p.trade_date) ), features AS ( SELECT trade_date AS signal_date, asset_code, asset_name, asset_type, sector, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, market_cap, ma20, ma60, high20, high60_prior, low20, CASE WHEN close_20d > 0 THEN (close_price - close_20d) / close_20d END AS ret20, CASE WHEN close_60d > 0 THEN (close_price - close_60d) / close_60d END AS ret60, CASE WHEN high20 > 0 THEN (close_price - high20) / high20 END AS drawdown20, CASE WHEN high60_prior > 0 THEN (close_price - high60_prior) / high60_prior END AS drawdown60, CASE WHEN high_price > low_price THEN (close_price - low_price) / NULLIF(high_price - low_price, 0) END AS candle_location, CASE WHEN open_price > 0 THEN (close_price - open_price) / open_price END AS body_ratio, CASE WHEN volume20_avg > 0 THEN COALESCE(volume, 0) / volume20_avg END AS volume_expansion, trade_amount20_avg, CASE WHEN close_price > 0 THEN (high20 - low20) / close_price END AS range20 FROM stock_base WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND close_price > 0 AND close_60d IS NOT NULL ) INSERT INTO quant_candle_feature_snapshot ( signal_date, asset_code, asset_name, asset_type, sector, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, market_cap, ma20, ma60, high20, high60_prior, low20, ret20, ret60, drawdown20, drawdown60, candle_location, body_ratio, volume_expansion, trade_amount20_avg, range20 ) SELECT signal_date, asset_code, asset_name, asset_type, sector, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, market_cap, ma20, ma60, high20, high60_prior, low20, ret20, ret60, drawdown20, drawdown60, candle_location, body_ratio, volume_expansion, trade_amount20_avg, range20 FROM features ON CONFLICT (signal_date, asset_code) DO UPDATE SET asset_name = EXCLUDED.asset_name, asset_type = EXCLUDED.asset_type, sector = EXCLUDED.sector, open_price = EXCLUDED.open_price, high_price = EXCLUDED.high_price, low_price = EXCLUDED.low_price, close_price = EXCLUDED.close_price, volume = EXCLUDED.volume, market_cap = EXCLUDED.market_cap, ma20 = EXCLUDED.ma20, ma60 = EXCLUDED.ma60, high20 = EXCLUDED.high20, high60_prior = EXCLUDED.high60_prior, low20 = EXCLUDED.low20, ret20 = EXCLUDED.ret20, ret60 = EXCLUDED.ret60, drawdown20 = EXCLUDED.drawdown20, drawdown60 = EXCLUDED.drawdown60, candle_location = EXCLUDED.candle_location, body_ratio = EXCLUDED.body_ratio, volume_expansion = EXCLUDED.volume_expansion, trade_amount20_avg = EXCLUDED.trade_amount20_avg, range20 = EXCLUDED.range20
mapper.select: WITH raw_months AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date AS month_key, MIN(trade_date) AS rebalance_date, MAX(trade_date) AS exit_date FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date ), months AS ( SELECT rm.*, ( SELECT MAX(signal_date) FROM quant_candle_feature_snapshot WHERE signal_date < rm.rebalance_date ) AS pick_signal_date FROM raw_months rm ), regime AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, CASE WHEN idx.close_price IS NULL OR ma.ma120 IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN idx.close_price > ma.ma120 AND (ma.ma200 IS NULL OR idx.close_price > ma.ma200) THEN 'RISK_ON' WHEN idx.close_price > ma.ma120 THEN 'NEUTRAL' ELSE 'RISK_OFF' END AS regime_state FROM months m LEFT JOIN market_daily_price idx ON idx.asset_type = 'INDEX' AND idx.asset_code = 'KOSPI' AND idx.trade_date = m.pick_signal_date LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT AVG(close_price) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 120) AS ma120, AVG(close_price) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 200) AS ma200 FROM ( SELECT close_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'INDEX' AND asset_code = 'KOSPI' AND trade_date <= m.pick_signal_date ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 200 ) rows ) ma ON TRUE ), filtered AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, m.exit_date, f.*, r.regime_state, (f.close_price / NULLIF(f.high60_prior, 0)) AS breakout_ratio FROM months m JOIN quant_candle_feature_snapshot f ON f.signal_date = m.pick_signal_date LEFT JOIN regime r ON r.rebalance_date = m.rebalance_date WHERE f.high60_prior IS NOT NULL AND f.ma20 IS NOT NULL AND f.ma60 IS NOT NULL AND f.trade_amount20_avg > 0 AND f.close_price >= f.high60_prior * 0.995 AND f.close_price > f.ma20 AND f.close_price > f.ma60 AND f.ma20 >= f.ma60 * 0.98 AND f.close_price >= f.open_price AND COALESCE(f.candle_location, 0) >= 0.60 AND COALESCE(r.regime_state, 'UNKNOWN') IN ('RISK_ON', 'NEUTRAL', 'UNKNOWN') ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY breakout_ratio), 0) AS breakout_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY (COALESCE(ret20, 0) + COALESCE(ret60, 0))), 0) AS trend_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY trade_amount20_avg), 0) AS liquidity_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY (COALESCE(candle_location, 0) + COALESCE(body_ratio, 0))), 0) AS candle_strength_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY volume_expansion), 0) AS volume_expansion_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY range20 DESC NULLS LAST), 0) AS stability_rank FROM filtered ), scored AS ( SELECT *, 0.30 * breakout_rank + 0.20 * trend_rank + 0.20 * liquidity_rank + 0.15 * candle_strength_rank + 0.10 * volume_expansion_rank + 0.05 * stability_rank - CASE WHEN regime_state = 'NEUTRAL' THEN 0.05 ELSE 0 END AS score FROM ranked ), candidates AS ( SELECT s.rebalance_date, s.exit_date, buy.asset_code, buy.asset_name, buy.asset_type, buy.sector, COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price) AS buy_price, COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) AS sell_price, s.score, buy.market_cap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.rebalance_date ORDER BY s.score DESC, s.liquidity_rank DESC, buy.market_cap DESC NULLS LAST, buy.asset_code) AS pick_rank FROM scored s JOIN market_daily_price buy ON buy.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND buy.asset_code = s.asset_code AND buy.trade_date = s.rebalance_date JOIN market_daily_price sell ON sell.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND sell.asset_code = s.asset_code AND sell.trade_date = s.exit_date ) SELECT rebalance_date AS rebalanceDate, exit_date AS exitDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, asset_type AS assetType, sector, buy_price AS buyPrice, sell_price AS sellPrice, score, market_cap AS marketCap, pick_rank AS pickRank FROM candidates WHERE pick_rank <= #{topN} ORDER BY rebalance_date, pick_rank

WITH raw_months AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date AS month_key, MIN(trade_date) AS rebalance_date, MAX(trade_date) AS exit_date FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date ), months AS ( SELECT rm.*, ( SELECT MAX(signal_date) FROM quant_candle_feature_snapshot WHERE signal_date < rm.rebalance_date ) AS pick_signal_date FROM raw_months rm ), regime AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, CASE WHEN idx.close_price IS NULL OR ma.ma120 IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN idx.close_price > ma.ma120 AND (ma.ma200 IS NULL OR idx.close_price > ma.ma200) THEN 'RISK_ON' WHEN idx.close_price > ma.ma120 THEN 'NEUTRAL' ELSE 'RISK_OFF' END AS regime_state FROM months m LEFT JOIN market_daily_price idx ON idx.asset_type = 'INDEX' AND idx.asset_code = 'KOSPI' AND idx.trade_date = m.pick_signal_date LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT AVG(close_price) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 120) AS ma120, AVG(close_price) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 200) AS ma200 FROM ( SELECT close_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'INDEX' AND asset_code = 'KOSPI' AND trade_date <= m.pick_signal_date ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 200 ) rows ) ma ON TRUE ), filtered AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, m.exit_date, f.*, r.regime_state, ABS(COALESCE(f.drawdown20, -1) - -0.08) AS pullback_distance, CASE WHEN f.ma60 > 0 THEN (f.ma20 - f.ma60) / f.ma60 END AS ma_spread FROM months m JOIN quant_candle_feature_snapshot f ON f.signal_date = m.pick_signal_date LEFT JOIN regime r ON r.rebalance_date = m.rebalance_date WHERE f.ma20 IS NOT NULL AND f.ma60 IS NOT NULL AND f.high20 IS NOT NULL AND f.trade_amount20_avg > 0 AND f.ma20 > f.ma60 AND f.close_price BETWEEN f.ma20 * 0.97 AND f.ma20 * 1.05 AND f.close_price >= f.open_price AND f.low_price >= f.ma60 * 0.95 AND f.ret60 > 0 AND f.drawdown20 BETWEEN -0.18 AND -0.03 AND COALESCE(r.regime_state, 'UNKNOWN') IN ('RISK_ON', 'NEUTRAL', 'UNKNOWN') ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY (COALESCE(ret60, 0) + COALESCE(ma_spread, 0))), 0) AS trend_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY body_ratio), 0) AS rebound_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY pullback_distance DESC NULLS LAST), 0) AS pullback_quality_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY trade_amount20_avg), 0) AS liquidity_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY (COALESCE(candle_location, 0) + COALESCE(body_ratio, 0))), 0) AS candle_strength_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY range20 DESC NULLS LAST), 0) AS stability_rank FROM filtered ), scored AS ( SELECT *, 0.25 * trend_rank + 0.20 * rebound_rank + 0.20 * pullback_quality_rank + 0.15 * liquidity_rank + 0.10 * candle_strength_rank + 0.10 * stability_rank - CASE WHEN regime_state = 'NEUTRAL' THEN 0.05 ELSE 0 END AS score FROM ranked ), candidates AS ( SELECT s.rebalance_date, s.exit_date, buy.asset_code, buy.asset_name, buy.asset_type, buy.sector, COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price) AS buy_price, COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) AS sell_price, s.score, buy.market_cap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.rebalance_date ORDER BY s.score DESC, s.liquidity_rank DESC, buy.market_cap DESC NULLS LAST, buy.asset_code) AS pick_rank FROM scored s JOIN market_daily_price buy ON buy.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND buy.asset_code = s.asset_code AND buy.trade_date = s.rebalance_date JOIN market_daily_price sell ON sell.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND sell.asset_code = s.asset_code AND sell.trade_date = s.exit_date ) SELECT rebalance_date AS rebalanceDate, exit_date AS exitDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, asset_type AS assetType, sector, buy_price AS buyPrice, sell_price AS sellPrice, score, market_cap AS marketCap, pick_rank AS pickRank FROM candidates WHERE pick_rank <= #{topN} ORDER BY rebalance_date, pick_rank

WITH raw_months AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date AS month_key, MIN(trade_date) AS rebalance_date, MAX(trade_date) AS month_exit_date FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY date_trunc('month', trade_date)::date ), months AS ( SELECT rm.*, ( SELECT MAX(signal_date) FROM quant_candle_feature_snapshot WHERE signal_date < rm.rebalance_date ) AS pick_signal_date, COALESCE(( SELECT d.trade_date FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT trade_date FROM market_daily_price WHERE asset_type = 'STOCK' AND trade_date >= rm.rebalance_date ORDER BY trade_date LIMIT 21 ) d ORDER BY d.trade_date DESC LIMIT 1 ), rm.month_exit_date) AS exit_date FROM raw_months rm ), filtered AS ( SELECT m.rebalance_date, m.exit_date, f.*, (f.close_price / NULLIF(f.high60_prior, 0)) AS breakout_ratio FROM months m JOIN quant_candle_feature_snapshot f ON f.signal_date = m.pick_signal_date WHERE f.high60_prior IS NOT NULL AND f.ma20 IS NOT NULL AND f.ma60 IS NOT NULL AND f.trade_amount20_avg > 0 AND f.close_price >= f.high60_prior * 0.95 AND f.close_price > f.ma20 AND f.close_price > f.ma60 AND f.ma20 >= f.ma60 * 0.98 AND f.close_price >= f.open_price AND COALESCE(f.candle_location, 0) >= 0.60 AND COALESCE(f.ret20, 0) >= 0.05 AND COALESCE(f.ret60, 0) >= 0.15 AND COALESCE(f.volume_expansion, 0) >= 0.80 AND COALESCE(f.range20, 0) <= 0.12 ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY breakout_ratio), 0) AS breakout_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY (COALESCE(ret20, 0) + COALESCE(ret60, 0))), 0) AS trend_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY trade_amount20_avg), 0) AS liquidity_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY (COALESCE(candle_location, 0) + COALESCE(body_ratio, 0))), 0) AS candle_strength_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY volume_expansion), 0) AS volume_expansion_rank, COALESCE(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rebalance_date ORDER BY range20 DESC NULLS LAST), 0) AS stability_rank FROM filtered ), scored AS ( SELECT *, 0.30 * breakout_rank + 0.25 * trend_rank + 0.20 * liquidity_rank + 0.10 * candle_strength_rank + 0.10 * volume_expansion_rank + 0.05 * stability_rank AS score FROM ranked ), candidates AS ( SELECT s.rebalance_date, s.exit_date, buy.asset_code, buy.asset_name, buy.asset_type, buy.sector, COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price) AS buy_price, COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) AS sell_price, s.score, buy.market_cap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.rebalance_date ORDER BY s.score DESC, s.liquidity_rank DESC, buy.market_cap DESC NULLS LAST, buy.asset_code) AS pick_rank FROM scored s JOIN market_daily_price buy ON buy.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND buy.asset_code = s.asset_code AND buy.trade_date = s.rebalance_date JOIN market_daily_price sell ON sell.asset_type = 'STOCK' AND sell.asset_code = s.asset_code AND sell.trade_date = s.exit_date WHERE COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price) > 0 AND COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) > 0 AND COALESCE(sell.open_price, sell.close_price) / NULLIF(COALESCE(buy.open_price, buy.close_price), 0) - 1 BETWEEN -0.95 AND 5.0 ) SELECT rebalance_date AS rebalanceDate, exit_date AS exitDate, asset_code AS assetCode, asset_name AS assetName, asset_type AS assetType, sector, buy_price AS buyPrice, sell_price AS sellPrice, score, market_cap AS marketCap, pick_rank AS pickRank FROM candidates WHERE pick_rank <= #{topN} ORDER BY rebalance_date, pick_rank
